- **India Coverage:** India (IND) is explicitly included in the geographic coverage list of the dataset ([Dataset FAQ](https://sites.research.google/gr/open-buildings/temporal)).
- **Years Covered:** Annual data spanning eight years from 2016 to 2023 ([Dataset Description](https://sites.research.google/gr/open-buildings/temporal)).
- **Grid Resolution:** Effective spatial resolution is approximately 4 meters, with raster files provided at 50 cm resolution ([Resolution FAQ](https://sites.research.google/gr/open-buildings/temporal)).
- **Height Accuracy Limitations:** The mean absolute error of building height prediction is 1.5 meters, though evaluation data was only available in North America, Europe, and Japan. Heights are relative measures (height above ground), capped at 100 meters, and may contain large errors for tall buildings in the Global South. Non-building mask artifacts (e.g., from trees) can affect readings, and heights must be used in conjunction with building presence rasters ([Resolution & Limitations FAQ](https://sites.research.google/gr/open-buildings/temporal)).
- **License:** Available under dual licensing: Creative Commons Attribution ([CC BY-4.0 License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)) and Open Data Commons Open Database License ([ODbL v1.0 License](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/)).
- **Access Routes:** Accessible as an Earth Engine Image Collection ([Earth Engine Catalog](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/GOOGLE_Research_open-buildings-temporal_v1)).
- **Public Anonymous Download Outside Earth Engine:** Yes, raster data can be downloaded directly from the [Google Cloud Storage Browser](https://console.cloud.google.com/storage/browser/open-buildings-temporal-data/v1) using the [Colab Download Notebook](https://colab.research.google.com/github/google-research/google-research/blob/master/building_detection/open_buildings_temporal_download_region_geotiffs.ipynb) for specific regions and timeframes.

<summary>The page provides comprehensive details about the Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal Dataset, confirming coverage for India across the years 2016-2023, an effective 4-meter resolution, and important height limitations including relative-only measurements and limited Global South ground-truth evaluation. It outlines dual licensing under CC BY-4.0 and ODbL v1.0. Crucially, it confirms that public anonymous downloads exist outside Earth Engine via Google Cloud Storage and a companion Colab notebook script.</summary>
